data.name: Venu
data.gender_notes: Venu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Venu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vayu', which means wind. It is also the name of the god of music and dance in Hindu mythology. Therefore, this name signifies both the natural element of wind and the creative and peaceful aspects of music. The name Venu carries the meaning “Wind, Melody” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Venu usually hope their child will grow to embody wind, melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the wind and the divine melody of music.
data.etymology: Venu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wind, Melody.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Venu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

It is a name that embodies creativity, peace, and beauty. The use of the Veena as a symbol of Vena highlights the idea that music and arts are a means to connect with the divine. The name Venu also represents the connection between the natural world and the creative world and reminding us of the harmony and balance in the universe.
